newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's SFO assesses complaint over Tui-Kiwi merger.
newsitem.headline: NZ's SFO assesses complaint over Tui-Kiwi merger.

text.p: New Zealand's Serious Fraud Office (SFO) said on Friday it was assessing a complaint related to the merger of Tui Milk Products and Kiwi Co-operative Dairies, the New Zealand Press Association reported.
"I can confirm that we have received a complaint," a spokeswoman for SFO director Charles Sturt told NZPA.
But a business newspaper today reported the complaint involved an information memorandum circulated by Kiwi directors to suppliers before the merger.
The memorandum set out the operating scenario for the merged company, with estimated earnings under the anticipated market conditions of the next few years.

The National Business Review also reported that since Tui shareholders last week voted in favour of the merger, questions had been raised about the sale of the Kiwi and Tui brands to Otago-based Mainland Products, a move not mentioned in the memorandum.
